title: Pais patent test at Pax River had no definitive results
place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

plain: In 2025 the Navy tested at least one of the unusual patents credited to an inventor named Salvatore Pais, at Naval Air Station Patuxent River in Maryland, but got no clear answer. This is what a congressman named Eric Burlison tells Michels: officials admitted to him that one of the designs had been put to a test, he believes the one meant to defeat gravity, and that they 'weren't able to have any definitive results.' If such a device worked, it would mean flight without ordinary propulsion, which is why a test at all is worth telling.
